title: Birthplace and father the drayman
summary: Dejan was born on Conti-area streets and raised in Tremé; his father, not a musician, rose from selling brick to become a leading Black drayman.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Where were you born? Just what part of town?
I was born on Conay between St. Louis and Conay. But I was raised around Tremay, you know, around St. Ann and Miro.
And your folks lived there long. Can you tell a little bit about your father? Was he a musician?

No, my father was not a musician. My father had it kind of tough coming up, but after he got to be drawn, he went on. My father told me, he used to tell me stories sometimes, he used to pound brick and sell brick to take care of his mother. Yeah, but after he came up, he started off with one mule and wagon. And he got to be the biggest colored boss dramman in his town.
What did he do with the- He was a dramman, he was a dramman.
Just like Maloney and Dyes and these other drammen.
